      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "suggested categorizing expired signatures separately and adding a flag to allow them"

      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "excluding expired keys by default could break verifying old releases or future verification of current releases when keys lapse",
      "quote": "will this break verifying old releases or current releases in the future?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author implemented --allow-expired flag as suggested by sedited and willcl-ark, who found the end result decent",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5736621483"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:5727040666"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5289620888",
      "status_by_quote": "The end result looks decent"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5727040666",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "categorize sigs from expired keys separately and add a flag that allows the user to treat them as good",
      "quote": "How about categorizing sigs from expired keys separately and adding a flag that allows the user to treat them as good?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added --allow-expired and reported expired sigs separately",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5736621483"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:5727162821"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5736621483",
      "status_by_quote": "Added `--allow-expired` for historical verification, with expired signatures reported separately"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5301316723",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "prompt or remind users that they should update keys periodically in local gpg",
      "quote": "I wonder if we should prompt/remind users that they should ideally update keys periodically.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added README note on stale local keyrings and reviewer approved",
      "author_replies": [
        "r:5312073949"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5312073949",
      "status_by_quote": "The latest push adds a short README note that stale local keyrings may miss revocations and keyserver updates can reveal requested keys"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4091158778",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "de-duplicate signatures by key or fingerprint rather than summing lengths",
      "quote": "should we be de-duplicating by key or fingerprint perhaps?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "both agreed to leave deduplication for a follow-up PR",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4100037715"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4091158778",
      "status_by_quote": "Anyway, probably for a followup..."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4091125514",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "whether the test should have an assertion for expired_sigs fields",
      "quote": "Do you think the test should have an assertion for these `expired_sigs` fields?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added test assertions for expired_sigs and reviewer approved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4100026521",
        "r:5312073949"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4100026521",
      "status_by_quote": "Sure, the `pub --json` test now checks that `expired_sigs` is a list, and the quorum test checks the expired signature’s full representation."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5315970979",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "verified recent releases (22.1 through 31.1) with and without --allow-expired; all passed default quorum with local keyring without exception",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "tested",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "nothing",
      "what": "all open items addressed and approved by reviewer",
      "id": ""
    }
  ],
  "notes": "l0rinc pushed updates addressing the test assertions and adding a README note about updating keys. willcl-ark tested the changes across multiple releases and provided an ACK."
}
